Meta.title: NewsMap
Meta.description: Global news aggregator with geographic curation. Browse today's headlines from Argentina, Spain, the UK, Germany, Italy and more — no algorithm, no account required.

Landing.headline: Your world news, on the map
Landing.subheadline: Choose the publications you want to read. No algorithm — just the sources you pick.
Landing.feature_map_desc: Explore countries and subscribe to the publications that interest you.
Landing.feature_rss_desc: Many sources include full article previews — read the complete story inside NewsMap, no redirect needed. Updated every 15 min.
Landing.feature_i18n_desc: Latin America, USA, UK, Spain, Germany, Italy, France and more. Interface in Spanish and English.

Onboarding.profile_spain_desc: El País, El Mundo, El Confidencial and La Vanguardia.
Onboarding.profile_custom_desc: Pick the countries and sources you want to follow yourself.
